namespace N {
  export interface Foo<T = number> { v: T }
  export class C<T = number> { constructor(public v: T) {} }
  export type Opt<T = number> = { v: T };
  export interface I<T = string> { s: T }
  export class Base<T = number> { b?: T }
  export interface Box<T> { v: T }
}
const f: N.Foo = { v: 1 };
const c: N.C = new N.C(1);
const o: N.Opt = { v: 1 };
class X extends N.Base implements N.I { s = 'x'; }
const bad: N.Box = { v: 1 };
const bad2: N.Box<number, string> = { v: 1 };
console.log(f.v, c.v, o.v, new X().s, bad, bad2);
